findings.text: follow-on: the --report help text reads "Report mode (the default and, for now, the only mode)" and the command docstring at sn.py:5978 opens "Read-only pattern-family harmonization report.", both made false by the --apply option added in the same change, so sn harmonize --help tells a reader no apply mode exists.

follow-on: _harmonize_drain duplicates the existing _campaign_drain closure at sn.py:2797-2824 near-verbatim (same row lookup and cost_spent extraction), leaving two copies to drift as the drain contract changes.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 7597c4f6ff911c6eba153684cd598b858c935799; 4f93f24bd adds batch_plan to CampaignRunner.run and anchor_gated_batches, 24e68d8c8 adds plan_family_applies/apply_families plus the CLI --apply, and 102ff8b59 adds the fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a failed anchor to leave members untouched with the gate removed, an accepted anchor followed by one member batch, a snapshot before every reset restorable from, a second apply planning zero calls, and a --dry-run writing nothing; tests/standard_names/test_harmonize_apply.py holds one test per item and the manifest records baseline 161 passed and after 166 passed at 102ff8b59.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is the sn harmonize --apply mechanism — the anchor-first two-batch apply of one pattern family, proven on fixtures; imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py:754 plan_family_applies builds the batch sequence through campaign.py:500 anchor_gated_batches and harmonize.py:825 apply_families drives one CampaignRunner per family, so the landed change is exactly that mechanism.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, the three commits 4f93f24bd 24e68d8c8 102ff8b59, baseline_suite 161 passed EXIT=0 completed, after_suite 166 passed EXIT=0 completed, and the negative control negcontrol-apply.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares imas_codex/cli/sn.py, imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py, imas_codex/standard_names/campaign.py, imas_codex/standard_names/families.py, the two test files and the fragment; git diff --name-only 7597c4f6f..102ff8b59 names exactly those plus no other file.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_harmonize_apply.py:210 fails when the anchor acceptance gate is removed through SHC_NO_ANCHOR_GATE, proving the assertion guards the gate rather than restating an input.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records the gate run at 102ff8b59 as 166 passed EXIT=0 in after-suite.log with baseline 161 passed, and negcontrol-apply.log reproduces the failing gate-removal arm the done_when requires.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/cli/sn.py:5935 still reads "for now, the only mode" and the docstring at sn.py:5978 still says read-only, both made false by the --apply option this same change adds.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/harmonize.py:783 anchors the batch plan through anchor_gated_batches and harmonize.py:880 runs the anchor batch ahead of the member batch, which is the delivered goal.
justifications.reuse: the runner gains an optional batch_plan at imas_codex/standard_names/campaign.py:957 rather than a second runner and reuses select_anchor, group_signature and stamp_harmonized_families, but imas_codex/cli/sn.py:6078 _harmonize_drain duplicates the existing _campaign_drain closure at sn.py:2797.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 7597c4f6f..102ff8b59 is inside the manifest's declared write paths, with only the small describe() fallback at imas_codex/standard_names/campaign.py:172 beyond the goal's direct reach but inside a declared path.
